title: A1RL0CK
author: Marco Innocenti
description:
Your hands. They hit the reinforced metal. They're starting to hurt. There's nothing to do.
The safety lock is engaged.

-----

A1RL0CK is a survival text adventure about a child and some voices. Also, a lot of proteins. If you are looking for the kind of game that goes: "This is what happened and this is what you must do", A1RL0CK is probably not for you as it has an in media res approach and may result obscure to many players until quite far in the playthrough. It's a story meant to unfold step by step and it is intended to work like this. Rel.3.1 is the post-PunyJam#3 polished version with an added scoring system and a lot of vanilla systems in which to play (included C64, Spectrum +3, AtariST, Amiga, Apple II, BBC Micro) , and we recommend you play this one.
Check ReadMe.txt for a full disclosure on what changed in the game.

-----

*** CONTENT WARNING ***

May contain scenes not suitable for all audiences, like physical violence and psychological torment.
No children were harmed in the making of this game.
